- Archive handling is on track. Treat Bea’s album as accessible only through Nell and its loan record, but not as untouchable: inventory and written condition description are allowed; scanning, copying, publication, and display are not.

- Maintain the completed Monday-night continuity: Rosa and Martin’s booked 19:00–19:40 session finished, with the boards restored securely to the auditorium side wall and Owen’s offered help treated as completed. Dev’s audible test did not occur; Hana did not attend.

- Current time is Tuesday 15 September, after lunch. Rowan’s “work until the end of my agreed shift” supports a quiet time skip; no exact finishing hour has been established, so avoid inventing one. Do not manufacture an interruption.

- The voices and practical motives have generally stayed distinct: Nell procedural, Bea reflective but concrete, Dev accountable for his booking error, Rosa protecting her work time. Continue easing off clustered repartee; let people sometimes simply acknowledge a point and carry on.

- Keep separate-material references cautious. Bea’s earlier mention of “old usher photographs” is not established permission to access or exhibit anything, and should not be assumed to mean the green album or a distinct available collection without clarification.

- Plausible independent pressure: Owen needs to address his Thursday interview/Thursday cinema-shift conflict before Wednesday noon, likely with Nell; only Jo knows so far. Rowan should not learn it unless someone tells him or he directly overhears it.

- Other quiet developments can proceed offstage: Dev can obtain Hana’s availability and request a diary slot; Rosa can prepare her Wednesday layout submission while preserving Tuesday evening with Beth; Bea may later seek consent from people in the album, without assuming the result.
